the Slab JFET Preamp and Boost is a beautifully versatile Boost, Overdrive, Distortion and Fuzz - Multi-Gain Pedal Jul 17, 2025 12:00 by  Stefan Karlsson Boost Boost and Overdrive Concrete Sound Lab Distortion Drive Dual-Drive Fuzz Multi-Drive Multi-Gain Overdrive Silicon Fuzz + - Full Article Read Summary Key Points Concrete Sound Lab’s first pedal, designed by Josh, is the Slab JFET Preamp and Boost: a Boost, Overdrive, Distortion and Fuzz multi-gain pedal. It has a Purple marbled paint job, silver-top Boss-style knobs and six controls: Pre-Gain Low, Pre-Gain High, Gain, Boost, Tone (Post-gain LPF) and Level, plus Boost and Main Bypass footswitches. It is a JFET tube-emulating circuit, possibly Fetzer adjacent. Boost independence is unclear, and touch-sensitivity and dynamics cannot be established without hands-on use. The Concrete Sound Lab Webstore price is given as $200. The article includes a recap and four demo sections. I believe this is the first ever Concrete Sound Lab pedal - and what a wonderful job Josh has done here. The swirly Purple marbled paint job is fantastic, obviously I live those silver-top Boss-style knobs too - which are creatively arranged. This is a very straightforward discrete circuit with 6 intuitive controls : Controls - Pre-Gain Low, Pre-Gain High, Gain, Boost, Tone (Post-gain LPF), Level, Boost Footswitch, Main Bypass Footswitch. It’s not clear if that Boost is independent - but that would certainly be the cherry on top! As a first creation it’s an incredibly strong start to a brand - I like the iconography of the logo too. This is JFET tube-emulating circuit - possibly somewhat Fetzer adjacent - which circuits I always seem to like. Generally there is a lot to like here - I can’t establish the touch-sensitivity feel or dynamics for the pedal without trying it hands on. But this seems like a pretty perfect execution for me. The Slab is really well priced at $200 from the Concrete Sound Lab Webstore - I will very much be coming for one of these before long. Just a really attractive and appealing pedal. And it ranges into all the different food groups - including Fuzz - which is why I’ve billed it as a multi-gain machine rather than multi-drive. I’m very much looking forward to landing one of these! Concrete Sound Lab browse by type volume/amplification amplification preamp / clean boost browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Concrete Sound Lab Slab Published on July 16, 2025 Concrete Sound Lab boost / preamp fuzz overdrive pedal acid etched acid etched acid etched acid etched Information Slab is a dirty, lo-fi gain pedal with a range that goes from clean-ish into overdrive and fuzz. A tube-like JFET preamp section with a James tone stack drives a responsive silicon bi-polar transistor output stage. There's also a footswitch-activated JFET boost to overdrive the preamp stage, adding more gain and harmonic saturation. The pre-gain tone stack provides control over which frequency ranges are emphasized and is a powerful tool for shaping the texture of the overdriven sound. The post-gain tone knob is a passive low-pass filter to dial back any unwanted harshness and shape the final sound. Slab is an all-transistor design, hand-soldered with all through-hole construction except for the surface-mount JFETS. Every transistor is tested before soldering, and every pedal is calibrated and tested after assembly to ensure quality and consistency. Mono in and out. Use with a 9V center negative power supply only.
